messages:
Evan Park: hi folks, just received my MacBook (assigned in Okta) but Kandji shows "enrollment failed: device not assigned". mac is stuck at "Waiting for MDM profile" on setup assistant. any ideas?
Maya Singh: welcome Evan! that error usually means the serial in Apple Business Manager (ABM) doesn't match the claim we have. did you get the asset tag sticker or serial in the packing slip?
Evan Park: serial on the box is C02XYZ9876, onboarding email lists C02XYZ9876 as my device. i grabbed serial from About This Mac and it's C02XYZ9876 too. weird.
IT Onboard Bot: Auto-check: ABM record lookup for serial C02XYZ9876 returns claim_status: assigned_to_other_org. Suggest opening a ticket to device-procurement to request ABM transfer. Generated ticket #ONB-9091.
Maya Singh: ah that explains it. sometimes vendors accidentally assign to a reseller org during purchase. @Evan, we can either reassign the serial in ABM (procurement takes care) or do a temporary local admin push so you can finish setup. Which do you prefer?
Evan Park: i'd rather not wait on procurement if there's a safe temporary path. how does the local admin flow work?
Kandji Admin: Runbook excerpt: create temp local admin via Kandji "bootstrap-local-admin" command targeted by serial. This creates an account 'onboard-temp' valid for 24h. Requires approval from IT.
Maya Singh: I'll approve now and trigger the bootstrap. Evan, stay on the Wi-Fi named "Onboard" or plug into ethernet and don't reboot until I confirm.
Maya Singh: approved and job queued. Kandji reports job success. please check for a new local account named "onboard-temp" on the login screen.
Evan Park: saw account, logged in, finished setup. Kandji now shows device online but ABM still shows assigned_to_other_org. will procurement fix ABM later?
Maya Singh: yes procurement will coordinate transfer with the reseller. once ABM ownership is transferred we'll re-sync and remove the temp account. Evan, please leave a note in the onboarding doc about checking ABM status if enrollment fails.
Evan Park: done, thanks Maya and team! :tada:
